notes.title: Sips and Sonnets, our second title, coming this Sep!
notes.content: [p]Thank you so much for playing Backspace Backspace Backspace. Your support has allowed us to fund and complete our next game, Sips and Sonnets![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116074/294e3257f79d20c23503e71b8fc8d957f7d60f8f.png"][/img][/p][p]Play as a kind elderly lady in the British countryside in Sips and Sonnets. Two amazing voice actors have lent their talents to our game:[/p][p][/p][p]Bethan Dixon Bate (Baldur's Gate 3's Vlaakith, Vermintide's Sienna) is voicing our protagonist, Miss Meadows! [/p][p][/p][p]Sips and Sonnets is coming to you on Steam this September, for both Windows and Mac. We hope you take the time to wishlist it so you can be notified when it's finally out! notes.title: Thank you for 1,000!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116074/4a241990d8cc661aabaed3b9985275d4fa14572a.png[/img]

We officially sold 1,000 copies of Backspace Backspace Backspace. Our tiny game reached this milestone thanks to YOU! We are so grateful for your support and the kind words you shared with us in your reviews. <3

Every little thing you do to help small indie teams like us makes a bigger difference than you can imagine. For instance, your support for Backspace Backspace Backspace has helped us partially fund our next game, Sips and Sonnets, which is already available to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176190/Sips_and_Sonnets/]wishlist[/url] on Steam!

Also, here are some fun Backspace Backspace Backspace statistics. Our top 5 countries are:
1. United States, accounting for 38% of our sales.
2. Saudi Arabia, 8%. 
3. China, 6%.
4. UK, 6%.
5. Turkey, 5%.
Followed by Canada, Brazil, Russia, France, Korea, and Germany!

If you liked Backspace Backspace Backspace, recommend it to your friends, share the news, and leave a Steam review :)

Don't let your creative spark get snuffed out! 

Keep making!
Blue Tango Street

notes.title: Announcing our new game!
notes.content:
Thank you for the immense support you've given us. We're very happy our game Backspace Backspace Backspace can now be enjoyed in multiple languages, making it accessible and relatable to even more people around the world! 

We're excited to announce our next game, Sips and Sonnets! A visual novel about tea making and poetry writing! In this heartfelt tale of Ms. Meadows, you explore life after the age of 60, and what it means to have most of your life already behind you. You can take part in lighthearted conversations with customers as you serve them different kinds of tea, and help Ms Meadows write her final poem as she contemplates what she holds most dear.

Sips and Sonnets is in full production now, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176190/Sips_and_Sonnets/]you can wishlist it here[/url].

Here are little glimpses of the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116074/2fde4d67c1b80a8ab6d34f58582ed8c6b13e001b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116074/6e59f3da36e7d13ba0c75dc8b5fc472dc5d92880.jpg[/img]

If you enjoyed Backspace Backspace Backspace, we hope you will enjoy Sips and Sonnets, as well.

Thank you again for your kind words and support, which mean the world to us!

notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes - Patch Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello hello! 

Our second patch update is here. Thank you for reporting!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed canvas aspect ratio on 1080p monitors, thanks to [url=https://x.com/indiesaudi]Abdullah Hamed[/url] for the help! 
- Fixed typos in Turkish and minor punctuations in English. 
- Fixed showing the background main menu video on Steam Deck. 
- Music/SFX slider now works! Can't believe we shipped the game while they were broken...

[b]Known bugs to be fixed... Someday: [/b]
- On some devices, after finishing the game and rolling the credits, pressing esc doesn't take you to the main menu :(

notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes - Patch Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello hello! 

Our first patch update is here. Thank you for reporting!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fix the giant white space at the bottom of the author’s note.
- Fix typos: materialize line 638, Jones line 452.
- Minor script clean-ups. 
- Finishing the game, displaying the credit, going back to main menu, then starting the game again should work fine now (it used to get stuck). 
- Add End of Act2 achievement in Arabic. 
- Pressing ESC while having the return to main menu confirmation message will close it.

[b]Improvements: [/b]
- Reduce time to start the game (from 3 to 2 seconds). 
- Temporarily disable save/load functionality until we fix all its related bugs. Sorry :( This shit is hard…

notes.title: Backspace Backspace Backspace is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We're excited for you to experience the story of our first game, Backspace Backspace Backspace!

We made this humble visual novella in one week. Debugging and further touch-ups took two months. We never created pixel art or original music before, so we used this project as an opportunity to push ourselves outside our comfort zone and grow more independent as a team of two. Above all else, Backspace Backspace Backspace is our love letter to every creative soul out there. Keep making!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116074/485d60aa344365b637c8e59fe296559672e7c581.gif[/img]

The release trailer is available below! 

[previewyoutube=kfF9gOMKEYA;full][/previewyoutube]

We have many more games lined up in the near future. If you would like to support us further, we would be immensely grateful to you. Leave us a review, tell your friends about this game, or purchase the Backspace Backspace Backspace soundtrack (which is also available on YouTube for free).
